command: pnpm fixtures || exit $?; cargo test --workspace --no-fail-fast; test_status=$?; cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings; clippy_status=$?; printf "workspace_test_exit=%s clippy_exit=%s\n" "$test_status" "$clippy_status"; if [ "$test_status" -ne 0 ]; then exit "$test_status"; fi; exit "$clippy_status"
